therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Polyamine synthesis inhibition to prevent neuroblastoma recurrence
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: High risk patients with neuroblastoma in remission

results.effect_size: Stratum 1: 84% EFS (95% CI: 80-88%), Stratum 2: 51% EFS (95% CI: 43-59%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Peak plasma concentration (Cmax) 11958 ng/mL (95% CI: 5123-18793), AUC 47024 hr*ng/mL (95% CI: 23868-70180), Tmax 3.3 hours (95% CI: 1.9-4.7)
biomarker_changes: ODC1 genotype association with survival tested (p-values: GG,GT,TT: 0.96; GG or GT,TT: 0.58; GG,GT or TT: 0.67)
subgroup_findings: Stratum 1 had higher EFS (84%) and OS (97%) compared to Stratum 2 (51% EFS, 84% OS)
results.dose_information: 500 to 1000 mg/m2 BID orally for 27 cycles of 28 days each
